assets.prompt: A high-resolution landscape photograph of only a warm dark walnut wooden tabletop, directly overhead, edge-to-edge wood, no objects. Natural subtle grain, fine worn pores, narrow unobtrusive seams between broad horizontal planks, matte oiled surface, warm diffused light from upper left and gently darker lower right. Brown tones, not orange. Surface for a realistic Codenames tabletop app, no text, no graphics, no vignette frame. 1536x1024.
